name: San Elijo Hills Town Center
demographics: San Elijo Hills Town Center serves the affluent master-planned community of San Elijo Hills in San Marcos, attracting primarily upper-middle-class families with median household incomes exceeding $100,000. The primary visitor base consists of residents aged 25-54 with children, reflecting the family-oriented nature of the surrounding neighborhood. The trade area is characterized by well-educated professionals who value convenience and quality, seeking everyday shopping and dining options within their community. Shopping patterns emphasize regular visits for groceries, services, and casual dining rather than destination retail trips.
description: San Elijo Hills Town Center serves as the vibrant commercial heart of the San Elijo Hills master-planned community in San Marcos, California. Developed and managed by Gershman Properties, LLC, a national real estate investment and property management company headquartered in Los Angeles, this neighborhood shopping destination provides essential retail and dining services to one of North County San Diego's most desirable residential communities. The center operates daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM, offering convenient access to residents seeking everyday amenities close to home. Strategically located within the carefully planned San Elijo Hills development, the Town Center reflects the community's commitment to walkability and neighborhood-oriented retail. As part of Gershman Properties' diverse portfolio, San Elijo Hills Town Center exemplifies the company's focus on community-serving retail properties that enhance the quality of life for surrounding residents.
summary: San Elijo Hills Town Center is a neighborhood shopping destination serving the master-planned community of San Elijo Hills in San Marcos, California. Managed by Gershman Properties, the center provides convenient retail and dining options for one of North County San Diego's premier residential communities.
